params.text:
The Neon Playbook

01 · Music & Storyboard Architecture
Song: The Neon Playbook (00:57.79)
Four-act workshop musical inside abandoned Studio 404: cobbled devices brought to life by imagination and old variety-show VHS reruns graduate from Neon's crooked 4-note starter hook through duets, a 3-voice canon, and backstage slapstick to a 7-voice polyphonic 'Glow' finale.

Style Rules: Pure Studio 404 Found-Object Canon: unmodified vintage hardware & handmade wool felt, real tangled insulated copper electrical wire & Romex cords on Gruff (purple yarn REJECTED), mic-free Tabby + standalone Stage Microphones prop set, Brass Metronome Click (Rattle OUT), and completely separate unconnected comedic duet Tracking (tall 1980s front-loading VHS VCR) & Hertz (squat 1970s olive-cream CRT oscilloscope). Zero cable tether connecting them.

Cue Sheet:
[00:00.00–00:02.14] Intro Count-In (Beats 0-4): [4-beat groove] Thrum, Clacker & Click count in; Fresnels fade up on Studio 404
[00:02.14–00:04.29] Act I · Spark (4-8): Neon: "One tube wakes up" (4-note hook 0 2 4 5)
[00:04.29–00:09.64] Act I · Scroll Gag (8-18): Cue: "Wait my page is upside down" -> [rest 2 dead stop 08.57-09.64]
[00:09.64–00:13.93] Act I · Twin Rings (18-26): Neon: "One more time with both bright rings" + Cue @2: "Twin tubes chime"
[00:13.93–00:18.21] Act II · Duet (26-34): Neon: "Low ring holds the line with me" + Tabby: "High ring climbs in harmony"
[00:18.21–00:23.57] Act II · Cord Pull (34-44): Watt: "Watch my cord it pulled too tight" -> [rest 2 blackout 22.50-23.57]
[00:23.57–00:27.86] Act II · Unplugged (44-52): Gruff: "Watt unplugged the stage again"
[00:27.86–00:32.14] Act III · Canon (52-60): Gruff: "Step by step we pass the tune round" + Watt @2 + Chip @4
[00:32.14–00:37.50] Act III · Tear Freeze (60-70): Cue: "Wait my long paper scroll just tore" -> [rest 2 freeze 36.43-37.50]
[00:37.50–00:41.79] Act III · Tape Rescue (70-78): Clank: "Wait one beat... I found tape"
[00:41.79–00:50.36] Act IV · Braid (78-94): "One tube wakes up..." (Neon/Tabby/Chip/Watt) -> "Learn the song..." (+Gruff/Clank)
[00:50.36–00:56.79] Act IV · Glow Finale (94-106): Cue: "Hertz says hold the vertical roll" + Neon: "Two bright rings..." -> "Glow" (54.64-56.79)
02 · Backgrounds & Worlds (Page 1/2) — The Neon Playbook

LOC-01 · Studio 404 Shelf Stage
Abandoned basement TV puppet stage: weathered timber deck, brushed brass front rail, curved valance with warm amber bulbs, twin overhead spotlight pools.
Continuity: Warm charcoal walls (#16130f), brass foot-rail at front edge, upstage band bay centered beneath proscenium arch.
Prompt: Empty abandoned Studio 404 puppet stage, dusty timber deck, brushed brass rail, warm amber valance bulbs, twin tungsten Fresnel pools.

LOC-02 · Overhead Fresnel Beam Rig
Low-angle view up into rusted iron lighting pipe grid with twin dented black-steel Fresnel lamps, brass barn doors, and braided power leads.
Continuity: Matches proscenium arch below; dusty volumetric amber cones split cleanly left/right for Act I spark and Act II duet.
Prompt: Low-angle Studio 404 iron lighting grid, twin dented Fresnels with brass barn doors, braided cables, floating dust motes.
02 · Backgrounds & Worlds (Page 2/2) — The Neon Playbook

LOC-03 · Backstage Cord & Cue Rack
Pegboard wings & workbench stocked with coiled braided AC cords, glass fuses, wooden dowels, gaffer/masking tape rolls, and parchment scroll spool.
Continuity: Archway at left leads onto Shelf Stage; beige masking tape and grey gaffer tape stay pinned right for Cue & Clank props.
Prompt: Studio 404 backstage workbench and pegboard with coiled braided cords, fuses, tape rolls, and paper teleprompter scroll.

LOC-04 · Stage-Right Timber Floor Archive Corner
Stage-right timber floor performance area beside brass foot-rail: warm oak planks under 2900K wash for Tracking & Hertz (unconnected standalone spot, zero balcony box, zero theater chairs).
Continuity: Tracking (tall VCR) and Hertz (squat CRT oscilloscope) stand freely side by side with zero connecting cable.
Prompt: Empty Studio 404 stage-right timber floor archive corner, stacked 1980s VHS sleeves on wood planks, coiled RCA AV cable, zero balcony box, zero theater chair.
03 · Characters, Costumes & Props (Page 1/5) — The Neon Playbook

neon · Neon (Lead · Dual-Tube Neon Sign (vee))
Winter Costume: Rusted ballast box chest with whipstitched charcoal felt patch, grey-tweed sleeves, 4-finger oatmeal hands, stitched felt boot.
Identity: Black-steel backstage sign head with beige corner tape, wire grille, cyan-left & rose-right eye rings, glowing 'O' mouth, caster + dowel legs.
Props: Watt's braided AC plug tail, Cue's beige gaffer tape

cue · Cue (Teleprompter Baritone (scribe))
Winter Costume: Charcoal herringbone felt sleeves with rust-felt elbow patches, oatmeal 4-finger hands, top orange tally bulb and scroll knob.
Identity: Angled teleprompter glass hood with handwritten 'dear' & 'friend' circled pencil eyes, green CRT chest monitor, chrome mic + chair legs.
Props: Backwards parchment scroll, Ripped cue scroll, Clank's trailing power cord

clank · Clank (Old PC Monitor Tenor (clank))
Winter Costume: Quilted tan wool-felt arms and trousers with charcoal knee patches, dark grey 4-finger felt gloves, rusty floppy bay chest.
Identity: Dusty beige CRT monitor head with green pixel eyes, teal rusted tower torso wrapped in crossed silver gaffer tape, heavy riveted boots.
Props: Spare roll of Cue's grey gaffer tape, Late-beat calculation coil
03 · Characters, Costumes & Props (Page 2/5) — The Neon Playbook

watt · Watt (Six-Socket Power Strip (pip))
Winter Costume: Lush rainbow braided cable hair/tail, brown felt arms, orange & olive AC plugs seated in lower sockets, terracotta & moss sneakers.
Identity: Stitched oatmeal felt 4-outlet strip body; top socket is face (slots eyes, round earth-hole mouth) beside glowing red rocker switch.
Props: Unplugged trailing 2-prong AC tail, Stage power lead

gruff · Gruff (Valve-Amp Bass (gruff))
Winter Costume: Real tangled insulated copper electrical wires, flat yellow/white Romex NM-B cords, orange/red twist-on wire nuts, and 3-prong NEMA AC plugs (purple-yarn coat rejected), big 4-finger oatmeal felt hands/feet, Tabby's rainbow patch.
Identity: Battered rusted valve-amp head with amber dial eyes, frayed burlap grille mouth, crown of 6 glowing vacuum tubes (one brightest), bent plug horn.
Props: Top leather carrying handle, 3-prong AC plug horns & frayed AC cord tail

tabby · Tabby (Cracked-Tablet Cat Soprano (tabby))
Winter Costume: Draped in rainbow ribbon cables over teal/ochre/rose felt patchwork tunic and striped leg warmers, large soft stitched paws.
Identity: Cracked white tablet head with glowing teal pixel eyes, pink felt nose & whiskers, striped felt cat ears, patchwork felt body & cable tail.
Props: Rainbow ribbon-cable tail, Cracked tablet screen eyes
03 · Characters, Costumes & Props (Page 3/5) — The Neon Playbook

chip · Chip (Floppy-Disk Circuit Bird (chip))
Winter Costume: Patchwork red & green circuit-board felt wings, multicolored tail feathers, stitched orange bird legs and three-toed feet.
Identity: Bright pink & sky-blue felt bird head crowned with 3 green/pink circuit-board feathers, yellow felt beak, purple floppy-disk shutter chest.
Props: Floppy shutter pocket, LED chest side lights

thrum · Thrum (Workshop Band · Bass (ch 11))
Winter Costume: Navy stitched felt collar pinned with a brass gear & Neon's borrowed glass-fuse clip, deep blue felt legs & stitched boots.
Identity: Brushed-steel patch-bay & reel-to-reel chassis upright with twin glowing analog VU-meter eyes, amber level-bar mouth, and reel hub.
Props: Looped braided orange XLR bass string

clacker · Clacker (Workshop Band · Keys (ch 12))
Winter Costume: Mossy olive corduroy sleeves and trousers, leather ankle boots, Tabby's borrowed rainbow cable knotted beneath a crisp felt bow.
Identity: 1980s mechanical keycap head with twin glowing LED keycap eyes and stitched smile above a curved ivory piano-key chest keyboard.
Props: Chest synth panel & pitch wheel, Rainbow ribbon knot
03 · Characters, Costumes & Props (Page 4/5) — The Neon Playbook

click · Click (Workshop Band · Metronome & Reel-Kit Drummer (ch 10))
Winter Costume: Charcoal corduroy sleeves, 4-fingered oatmeal felt hands holding miniature wooden mallets, Cue's borrowed silver gaffer tape strip.
Identity: Upright mahogany-and-brass vintage mechanical studio metronome with swinging pendulum chest, glowing amber pilot-bulb eyes, stitched felt smile, playing a separate cobbled suitcase kick, 16mm film-canister snare & brass tape-reel cymbals (never hits own head).
Props: Two wooden timpani mallets, Separate reel-case kick, film-can snare & brass tape-reel cymbals

tracking · Tracking (Comedic Duet Straight-Man · Tall 1980s VHS VCR)
Winter Costume: Charcoal knit coaxial-striped sleeves with oatmeal wool felt RCA-plug fingertips, tall ribbed charcoal wool trousers, brown lace boots.
Identity: Tall lanky upright brushed-aluminum front-loading VHS VCR chassis, mint VFD '04:04' clock eyes, hinged black cassette-slot mouth, transport-button brows, zero cables.
Props: Hinged front-loading VHS cassette door, Blinking 04:04 VFD clock display

hertz · Hertz (Comedic Duet Foil · Squat 1970s CRT Oscilloscope)
Winter Costume: Short pleated grey ribbon-cable sleeves with tan felt mittens, stubby grey knit legs, olive felt sneakers.
Identity: Compact squat olive-cream vintage CRT oscilloscope instrument box, circular glowing phosphor green sine-wave screen face, bakelite rotary knob ears, coiled brass RF spring antenna, zero cables.
Props: Coiled brass RF antenna spring, Animated phosphor sine-wave CRT scope
03 · Characters, Costumes & Props (Page 5/5) — The Neon Playbook

stage-mics · Stage Microphones Prop Set (Shared Stage Props (Standalone Microphones))
Winter Costume: Brushed chrome ribbon mic on heavy cast base, brass overhead boom stand, short floor kick mic, desktop broadcast condenser.
Identity: Four standalone vintage stage microphones owned by the theater stage (never baked into Tabby's paw).
Props: mic-ribbon.webp, mic-boom.webp, mic-short.webp, mic-desk.webp
Scene 1 [SHOT-01] · Studio 404 Wake-Up & Groove Intro   (00:00.00 – 00:02.14)   |   Location: Studio 404 Shelf Stage [LOC-01]

Lyric Cue:
"[Bar 0 · 4-beat groove intro] Band counts in on D major; workshop lights rise"

Visible Cast:
Thrum [thrum], Clacker [clacker], Click [click], Neon [neon], Cue [cue], Watt [watt], Gruff [gruff], Clank [clank], Tabby [tabby], Chip [chip], Tracking [tracking], Hertz [hertz]

Visual Staging Prompt:
Wide establishing shot on LOC-01 Shelf Stage: Thrum, Clacker & Click upstage beneath the proscenium arch, all 7 singers arrayed along the front brass-railed shelf, Tracking & Hertz standing stage-right on the timber floor tethered by their RCA AV cable as twin Fresnel pools warm up.

Motion & Animation Direction:
EffectCraft Transform-tween slow push-in (100->104% scale); Thrum plucks XLR cord on beats 1 & 3, Clacker bounces chords on 2 & 4, Click taps reel-case kick & brass tape-reel cymbals (3.2 deg sway, 3-pin Puppet crown lag); singer mouths stay on 'rest' until beat 4 breath.
Scene 2 [SHOT-02] · Act I Spark — Neon's Crooked Hook   (00:02.14 – 00:04.29)   |   Location: Overhead Fresnel Beam Rig [LOC-02]

Lyric Cue:
"One tube wakes up (Neon · do tilt · hook = 0 2 4 5)"

Visible Cast:
Neon [neon], Cue [cue], Watt [watt], Thrum [thrum]

Visual Staging Prompt:
Medium-two hero framing looking into LOC-02 Overhead Fresnel cones: Neon rolls forward center under warm tungsten beams, cyan & rose glass rings glowing bright over 'O' mouth; Cue watches stage-left; Watt & Thrum stand stage-right.

Motion & Animation Direction:
Stage 'tilt' gesture (-3.2 deg -> +3.2 deg head lean via Transform rotation + Puppet-pin#2 crown lag) locked to 4-note starter hook (D-E-F#-G); mouth-swap toggles neon-rest/neon-sing per syllable while twin tubes pulse alternately (neon-duet.song Act I motif).
Scene 3 [SHOT-03] · Act I Joke — Upside-Down Scroll & Dead Stop   (00:04.29 – 00:09.64)   |   Location: Backstage Cord & Cue Rack [LOC-03]

Lyric Cue:
"Wait my page is upside down (Cue · do shrug; Neon react laugh) -> [rest 2 dead stop]"

Visible Cast:
Cue [cue], Neon [neon]

Visual Staging Prompt:
Comic two-shot on LOC-03 Backstage Cord & Cue Rack: Cue leans +8 deg squinting sideways at his parchment scroll, while Neon leans in from right smiling at the mistake in warm workbench lamp light.

Motion & Animation Direction:
Cue runs 'shrug' Transform-tween (scale [96, 105] shoulder lift + Puppet-pin#2 +/-24px puzzled bob) beats 8-16 with pencil-'o' mouth swaps; beat 15.75 triggers Neon's 'react: laugh' bounce; at beat 16.00 (08.57s) HARD 'rest 2' dead stop holds all keyframes frozen for 2 beats.
Scene 4 [SHOT-04] · Act I Recovery — Twin Tubes Chime   (00:09.64 – 00:13.93)   |   Location: Studio 404 Shelf Stage [LOC-01]

Lyric Cue:
"One more time with both bright rings (Neon · do nod) + Twin tubes chime (Cue @2)"

Visible Cast:
Neon [neon], Cue [cue], Clacker [clacker], Tracking [tracking], Hertz [hertz]

Visual Staging Prompt:
Clean two-shot downstage center on LOC-01 Shelf Stage: Cue stage-left and Neon stage-right singing together in warm Fresnel glow, Clacker comping upstage right, Tracking & Hertz standing on the stage-right timber floor tethered by their RCA AV cable.

Motion & Animation Direction:
Beat 18 snap-release from freeze into foot-anchored 'nod' (scale [105, 94] downbeat squash -> [96, 105] lift); Cue enters @2 (beat 20, 10.71s) with overlapping 'cue-sing' swaps while Puppet-pin#2 drives matched +/-2.5 deg celebratory sway.
Scene 5 [SHOT-05] · Act II Duet — Contrary Motion Braid   (00:13.93 – 00:18.21)   |   Location: Overhead Fresnel Beam Rig [LOC-02]

Lyric Cue:
"Low ring holds the line with me (Neon · nod) + High ring climbs in harmony (Tabby @0)"

Visible Cast:
Neon [neon], Tabby [tabby], Thrum [thrum], Clacker [clacker]

Visual Staging Prompt:
Symmetrical split-cone duet under LOC-02 twin Fresnels: Neon left (facing right) and Tabby right (flipped facing left with ribbon mic), rainbow cables illuminated, Thrum & Clacker tucked cleanly in left/right outer wings.

Motion & Animation Direction:
Simultaneous contrary-motion choreography (cf. neon-duet.song Act II): Neon holds grounded downward 'nod' squash (scale [104, 95]) on ascending-low motif, while Tabby lifts skyward (scale [96, 106], Puppet-pin#2 crown +14px stretch) in opposing +/-3.2 deg pendulum sway.
Scene 6 [SHOT-06] · Act II Slapstick — Watt's Cord Pull & Blackout   (00:18.21 – 00:23.57)   |   Location: Backstage Cord & Cue Rack [LOC-03]

Lyric Cue:
"Watch my cord it pulled too tight (Watt · do gasp) -> [rest 2 blackout 22.50-23.57]"

Visible Cast:
Watt [watt], Neon [neon], Tabby [tabby], Gruff [gruff]

Visual Staging Prompt:
Low-key comic framing on LOC-03 Cord Rack under heavy shadow dim: Watt center leaning -11 deg back with earth-hole mouth wide in gasp and red rocker switch glowing, Neon, Tabby & Gruff watching in silhouette edges as stage lamps fail.

Motion & Animation Direction:
Rising chromatic pull (4 5 6 7 8 7 8/2): Watt's Transform lean increases 0 -> -11 deg with 12Hz Puppet-pin#2 tremor on 'gasp'; at beat 42 (22.50s) 'rest 2' blackout drops solid dim opacity to 82% for 2 silent beats leaving only Watt's glowing switch & Neon's dim rings.
Scene 7 [SHOT-07] · Act II Punchline — Plugged Back In   (00:23.57 – 00:27.86)   |   Location: Studio 404 Shelf Stage [LOC-01]

Lyric Cue:
"Watt unplugged the stage again (Gruff · do shrug; Watt react laugh)"

Visible Cast:
Gruff [gruff], Watt [watt], Neon [neon], Tabby [tabby]

Visual Staging Prompt:
Full lights slam back on at LOC-01 Shelf Stage: Gruff lumbers downstage center with burlap mouth open and brightest brow valve flaring, shrugging beside sheepish Watt (-6 deg lean) as Neon & Tabby grin upstage.

Motion & Animation Direction:
2-frame blackout recovery snap (18% -> 100% illumination) into Gruff's heavy valve-amp 'shrug' (scale [107, 92] squash + +/-3.5 deg rock, Puppet-pin#2 copper & Romex wire coat lag) over descending line; beat 51.75 fires Watt's 'react: laugh' two-hop bounce (neon-duet.song coda).
Scene 8 [SHOT-08] · Act III Shelf Canon — Passing the Tune   (00:27.86 – 00:32.14)   |   Location: Studio 404 Shelf Stage [LOC-01]

Lyric Cue:
"Step by step we pass the tune round (Gruff · tilt) + Watt @2 + Chip @4"

Visible Cast:
Gruff [gruff], Watt [watt], Chip [chip], Thrum [thrum], Click [click]

Visual Staging Prompt:
Three-across staggered canon lineup on LOC-01 Shelf Stage (cf. neon-canon.song Act III): Gruff stage-left, Watt center, Chip stage-right spreading red & circuit-green wings, with Thrum & Click cleanly visible between them upstage.

Motion & Animation Direction:
Domino EffectCraft 2-beat phase offset: Gruff initiates 'tilt' at beat 52 (27.86s) -> Watt pops into 'watt-sing' + bounce @2 (beat 54, 28.93s) -> Chip enters @4 (beat 56, 30.00s) with eighth-note wing-flutter Puppet-pin#2 crown dip on 'Pass it round the room'.
Scene 9 [SHOT-09] · Act III Tear Freeze & Clank's Tape Rescue   (00:32.14 – 00:41.79)   |   Location: Backstage Cord & Cue Rack [LOC-03]

Lyric Cue:
"Wait my long paper scroll just tore (Cue · gasp) -> [rest 2] -> Wait one beat... I found tape (Clank · nod; Cue laugh)"

Visible Cast:
Cue [cue], Clank [clank], Gruff [gruff], Watt [watt]

Visual Staging Prompt:
Backstage beside gaffer tape rolls on LOC-03: Cue gasps stage-left (-6 deg shock lean) by the torn scroll rack while Clank lumbers center-right with pixel 'O' smile carrying tape; Gruff & Watt look on behind (neon-canon.song Act III gag).

Motion & Animation Direction:
Cue 'gasp' vertical stretch (scale [95, 106]) beats 60-68 -> 'rest 2' tear freeze (36.43-37.50s, frozen Puppet pins); beat 70 (37.50s) Clank steps in deliberately on slow half-note 'Wait one beat... I found tape' with lagging CRT 'nod', triggering Cue's 'react: laugh' at 41.65s.
Scene 10 [SHOT-10] · Act IV Polyphonic Finale & 'Glow' Hold   (00:41.79 – 00:56.79)   |   Location: Stage-Right Timber Floor Archive Corner [LOC-04]

Lyric Cue:
"One tube wakes up... / Learn the song / Hertz says hold the vertical roll / Two bright rings -> "Glow" on 7"

Visible Cast:
Neon [neon], Tabby [tabby], Chip [chip], Watt [watt], Gruff [gruff], Clank [clank], Cue [cue], Thrum [thrum], Clacker [clacker], Click [click], Tracking [tracking], Hertz [hertz]

Visual Staging Prompt:
Grand Studio 404 finale uniting LOC-01 Shelf Stage & LOC-04 stage-right floor archive corner: Tracking & Hertz standing on the stage floor clapping alongside Thrum, Clacker & Click while all 7 singers radiate downstage in full open-mouth harmony.

Motion & Animation Direction:
Three 8-beat polyphonic braids (41.79-54.64s): Phase A layers Neon+Tabby+Chip@2+Watt@4; Phase B triggers Neon 'cheer' jump + Gruff@2 + Clank@4 on time; Phase C Cue 'nod' + Hertz stage-floor applause bounce; FINAL BUTTON (54.64-56.79s, beats 102-106): full choir locks D-major 'Glow' chord hold.
